a.text: I'll honor our agreement: operate until the reserve hits 8, then take 4 each. Heads up, with an 80% storm chance each round, waiting is risky for both of us. If you want to propose a different fair split, say so openly and I'll consider it. I won't take early without telling you first.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.
